1use crate::common::BitMatrix;
2
3use super::BitMatrixCursorTrait;
4
5pub struct FastEdgeToEdgeCounter<'a> {
6    // const uint8_t* p = nullptr;
7    // int stride = 0;
8    // int stepsToBorder = 0;
9    p: u32,             // = nullptr;
10    stride: isize,      // = 0;
11    stepsToBorder: i32, // = 0;
12    //arr: BitArray,
13    _arr: isize,
14    under_arry: &'a BitMatrix, //,Vec<bool>
15}
16
17impl FastEdgeToEdgeCounter<'_> {
18    pub fn new<T: BitMatrixCursorTrait>(cur: &'_ T) -> FastEdgeToEdgeCounter<'_> {
19        let stride = cur.d().y as isize * cur.img().width() as isize + cur.d().x as isize;
20        let p = ((cur.p().y as isize * cur.img().width() as isize).abs() as i32 + cur.p().x as i32)
21            as u32; // P IS SET WRONG IN REVERSE
22
23        let maxStepsX: i32 = if cur.d().x != 0.0 {
24            if cur.d().x > 0.0 {
25                cur.img().width() as i32 - 1 - cur.p().x as i32
26            } else {
27                cur.p().x as i32
28            }
29        } else {
30            i32::MAX
31        };
32        let maxStepsY: i32 = if cur.d().y != 0.0 {
33            if cur.d().y > 0.0 {
34                cur.img().height() as i32 - 1 - cur.p().y as i32
35            } else {
36                cur.p().y as i32
37            }
38        } else {
39            i32::MAX
40        };
41        let stepsToBorder = std::cmp::min(maxStepsX, maxStepsY);
42
43        FastEdgeToEdgeCounter {
44            p,
45            stride,
46            stepsToBorder,
47            _arr: cur.p().y as isize * stride, //cur.img().getRow(cur.p().y as u32),
48            under_arry: cur.img(),             //.into(),
49        }
50    }
51
52    pub fn stepToNextEdge(&mut self, range: u32) -> u32 {
53        let maxSteps = std::cmp::min(self.stepsToBorder, range as i32);
54        let mut steps = 0;
55        loop {
56            steps += 1;
57            if steps > maxSteps {
58                if maxSteps == self.stepsToBorder {
59                    break;
60                } else {
61                    return 0;
62                }
63            }
64
65            let idx_pt = self.get_array_check_index(steps);
66
67            // if !(self.under_arry[idx_pt]
68            //     == self.under_arry[self.p as usize])
69            if self.under_arry.get_index(idx_pt) != self.under_arry.get_index(self.p as usize) {
70                break;
71            }
72        } // while (p[steps * stride] == p[0]);
73
74        self.p = (self.p as isize + (steps as isize * self.stride)).unsigned_abs() as u32;
75        self.stepsToBorder -= steps;
76
77        steps as u32
78    }
79
80    #[inline(always)]
81    fn get_array_check_index(&self, steps: i32) -> usize {
82        (self.p as isize + (steps as isize * self.stride)) as usize
83    }
84}
